text: The Sindh Resilience Project (SRP) is an initiative by the Government of Sindh, implemented by the Sindh Irrigation Department and the Provincial Disaster Management Authority, with financing from the World Bank. It aims to enhance the institutional capacity to manage riverine flood risks in Sindh, particularly along the Indus River. The project employs a Decision Support System (DSS) that integrates satellite imagery, numerical modeling, and real-time hydrometric data to aid in water resources planning and operational river monitoring before and during flood seasons.
